title: Grateful Dead Live at Tower Theatre on 1976-06-22
lineage: audience 1st generation reel - cassette Lineage: Master cassette audience> sony tc-755 reel w/teac an-180 dolby b (10.5" @ 7.5 ips); Transfer: 1st generation reel play back on Technics RS-1506>Sony NR-335>Tascam HD-P2 24/48

ai_review.summary: Moore's superb soundboard capture offers clear, low‑crowd audio, but the concert itself feels modest with few standout moments.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its excellent sound quality – a clean Moore soundboard mix with noticeably less crowd noise than other sources. While a couple of songs spark energy, reviewers generally describe the performance as lackluster and lacking memorable peaks.

ai_rating.rationale: Recording quality is consistently rated high (fantastic soundboard), but show performance receives mixed to lukewarm comments, resulting in a moderate overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note the mix is clean and less crowded; Moore's recording praised as fantastic with minimal ambient distraction.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; overall impression is that only a few numbers captured the band’s energy, making the show feel somewhat lackluster.

band_member_comments.Keys: Keith played a grand piano with a ‘steal your face’ flag draped over it, adding a unique blues opening.
